candidates.title: Wide Sargasso Sea
candidates.creator: Jean Rhys
candidates.rationale: My strongest overall choice: compressed psychological power, stylistic precision and a radical reworking of inherited colonial narrative.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1966. Tradition: Dominica / Britain. Original language: English.

candidates.title: A House for Mr Biswas
candidates.creator: V. S. Naipaul
candidates.rationale: The outstanding comic family epic here: an apparently small struggle for independence becomes a richly imagined human world.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1961. Tradition: Trinidad / Britain. Original language: English.

candidates.title: Notebook of a Return to the Native Land (Cahier d’un retour au pays natal)
candidates.creator: Aimé Césaire
candidates.rationale: A transformative fusion of lyric invention, historical reckoning and Black self-assertion; indispensable to the region’s poetic canon.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1939; later revised. Tradition: Martinique. Original language: French.

candidates.title: Omeros
candidates.creator: Derek Walcott
candidates.rationale: Epic ambition and extraordinary verbal music brought to Saint Lucian lives without making them mere replicas of classical heroes.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1990. Tradition: Saint Lucia. Original language: English.

candidates.title: The Black Jacobins
candidates.creator: C. L. R. James
candidates.rationale: Historical argument with narrative force: the Haitian Revolution becomes central rather than peripheral to the making of the modern world.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1938. Tradition: Trinidad. Original language: English.

candidates.title: The Kingdom of This World (El reino de este mundo)
candidates.creator: Alejo Carpentier
candidates.rationale: A short, formally concentrated vision of Haiti, revolution and belief, central to discussions of the marvellous real.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1949. Tradition: Cuba. Original language: Spanish.

candidates.title: In the Castle of My Skin
candidates.creator: George Lamming
candidates.rationale: Childhood, village life and colonial social change combine in a foundational Caribbean coming-of-age novel.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1953. Tradition: Barbados. Original language: English.

candidates.title: Masters of the Dew (Gouverneurs de la rosée)
candidates.creator: Jacques Roumain
candidates.rationale: Collective survival and rural conflict become a moving account of labour, solidarity and the possibility of renewal.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1944. Tradition: Haiti. Original language: French.

candidates.title: The Wretched of the Earth (Les Damnés de la terre)
candidates.creator: Frantz Fanon
candidates.rationale: Its analysis of decolonisation, violence and post-independence power gives it exceptional intellectual weight; influence does not imply universal agreement.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1961. Tradition: Martinique / Algeria. Original language: French.

candidates.title: The Arrivants: A New World Trilogy
candidates.creator: Kamau Brathwaite
candidates.rationale: A major poetic reconstruction of African-Caribbean history through rhythm, migration and the resources of spoken language.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1973. Tradition: Barbados. Original language: English / Caribbean nation language.

candidates.title: Texaco
candidates.creator: Patrick Chamoiseau
candidates.rationale: An ambitious collective history told through competing voices, urban struggle and the defence of marginalised memory.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1992. Tradition: Martinique. Original language: French, shaped by Creole.

candidates.title: Paradiso
candidates.creator: José Lezama Lima
candidates.rationale: One of the list’s most demanding formal achievements: baroque language, memory, sexuality and an expansive imaginative architecture.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1966. Tradition: Cuba. Original language: Spanish.

candidates.title: The Lonely Londoners
candidates.creator: Sam Selvon
candidates.rationale: Its invented vernacular narration makes migrant loneliness, humour and companionship inseparable from the form of the novel itself.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1956. Tradition: Trinidad / Britain. Original language: English / Creolised narrative idiom.

candidates.title: Palace of the Peacock
candidates.creator: Wilson Harris
candidates.rationale: A radical challenge to conventional realism, joining landscape, conquest, unstable identity and visionary transformation.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1960. Tradition: Guyana. Original language: English.

candidates.title: A Brief History of Seven Killings
candidates.creator: Marlon James
candidates.rationale: A formidable polyphonic achievement, linking Jamaican violence and political history to an international web of power.
candidates.note: Original publication: 2014. Tradition: Jamaica. Original language: English / Jamaican Creole.

candidates.title: Beyond a Boundary
candidates.creator: C. L. R. James
candidates.rationale: Cricket becomes a way to think about class, empire, culture and the author’s own formation.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1963. Tradition: Trinidad / Britain. Original language: English.

candidates.title: The Bridge of Beyond (Pluie et vent sur Télumée Miracle)
candidates.creator: Simone Schwarz-Bart
candidates.rationale: The strength lies in the voice: women’s experience, oral storytelling and endurance acquire exceptional lyrical depth.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1972. Tradition: Guadeloupe. Original language: French.

candidates.title: Three Trapped Tigers (Tres tristes tigres)
candidates.creator: Guillermo Cabrera Infante
candidates.rationale: Havana is recreated through talk, nightlife, parody and linguistic play; its difficulty is part of its artistic wager.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1967. Tradition: Cuba. Original language: Spanish.

candidates.title: Black Skin, White Masks (Peau noire, masques blancs)
candidates.creator: Frantz Fanon
candidates.rationale: An extraordinarily influential examination of racialisation, recognition, language and the psychological life of colonial domination.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1952. Tradition: Martinique. Original language: French.

candidates.title: The Dragon Can’t Dance
candidates.creator: Earl Lovelace
candidates.rationale: Carnival, dignity and marginalisation meet in a compelling exploration of how a community imagines resistance.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1979. Tradition: Trinidad. Original language: English / Trinidadian speech.

candidates.title: Capitalism and Slavery
candidates.creator: Eric Williams
candidates.rationale: A canon-changing historical intervention; its place rests partly on the enduring arguments it generated, not on unquestioned acceptance.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1944. Tradition: Trinidad. Original language: English.

candidates.title: Love, Anger, Madness (Amour, colère et folie)
candidates.creator: Marie Vieux-Chauvet
candidates.rationale: Psychological intensity and political terror reinforce each other in an uncompromising account of domination and resistance.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1968. Tradition: Haiti. Original language: French.

candidates.title: A Small Place
candidates.creator: Jamaica Kincaid
candidates.rationale: An unusually concentrated and unsettling challenge to the tourist gaze, colonial inheritance and postcolonial corruption.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1988. Tradition: Antigua. Original language: English.

candidates.title: Poetics of Relation (Poétique de la Relation)
candidates.creator: Édouard Glissant
candidates.rationale: A foundational way of thinking about identity through connection, difference and opacity rather than a single exclusive origin.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1990. Tradition: Martinique. Original language: French.

candidates.title: The Brief Wondrous Life of Oscar Wao
candidates.creator: Junot Díaz
candidates.rationale: Family memory, dictatorship and diaspora are reworked through a distinctive mixture of historical commentary and popular culture.
candidates.note: Original publication: 2007. Tradition: Dominican Republic / United States. Original language: English / Spanish code-switching.

candidates.title: Discourse on Colonialism (Discours sur le colonialisme)
candidates.creator: Aimé Césaire
candidates.rationale: Its rhetorical compression and attack on colonial civilisation claims make it a particularly forceful short work of anticolonial thought.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1950. Tradition: Martinique. Original language: French.

candidates.title: Before Night Falls (Antes que anochezca)
candidates.creator: Reinaldo Arenas
candidates.rationale: A fierce, artistically charged account of sexuality, literary life, persecution and exile.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1992. Tradition: Cuba / United States. Original language: Spanish.

candidates.title: The Book of Night Women
candidates.creator: Marlon James
candidates.rationale: Narrative voice and unsparing attention to plantation power distinguish it from more conventional historical fiction.
candidates.note: Original publication: 2009. Tradition: Jamaica. Original language: English / Jamaican Creole.

candidates.title: The Farming of Bones
candidates.creator: Edwidge Danticat
candidates.rationale: A restrained, emotionally devastating treatment of love, border violence and the struggle to preserve the dead in memory.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1998. Tradition: Haiti / United States. Original language: English.

candidates.title: Brown Girl, Brownstones
candidates.creator: Paule Marshall
candidates.rationale: Family conflict and property ownership become a searching account of migration, racial hierarchy and a daughter’s independence.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1959. Tradition: Barbadian / United States diaspora. Original language: English.

candidates.title: The Lost Steps (Los pasos perdidos)
candidates.creator: Alejo Carpentier
candidates.rationale: The search for an escape from modernity becomes an intricate interrogation of time, artistic creation and imagined origins.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1953. Tradition: Cuba. Original language: Spanish.

candidates.title: Segu (Ségou: Les Murailles de terre)
candidates.creator: Maryse Condé
candidates.rationale: A panoramic family narrative in which competing religious, commercial and imperial forces transform West African lives.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1984. Tradition: Guadeloupe. Original language: French.

candidates.title: Annie John
candidates.creator: Jamaica Kincaid
candidates.rationale: Mother-daughter attachment and separation are rendered with unusual precision, linking intimate rebellion to colonial education and authority.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1985. Tradition: Antigua. Original language: English.

candidates.title: Small Island
candidates.creator: Andrea Levy
candidates.rationale: Multiple perspectives make migration and postwar British belonging a richly human argument rather than a simple moral diagram.
candidates.note: Original publication: 2004. Tradition: Jamaican / British diaspora. Original language: English.

candidates.title: In the Time of the Butterflies
candidates.creator: Julia Alvarez
candidates.rationale: Individual voices and family relationships give historical resistance a vivid, intimate scale.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1994. Tradition: Dominican Republic / United States. Original language: English.

candidates.title: Miguel Street
candidates.creator: V. S. Naipaul
candidates.rationale: An exceptionally coherent story cycle: comedy, failure and affection accumulate into a portrait of an entire neighbourhood.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1959. Tradition: Trinidad. Original language: English.

candidates.title: How Europe Underdeveloped Africa
candidates.creator: Walter Rodney
candidates.rationale: Its account of exploitation and development has lasting intellectual importance; ranking it highly is not endorsing every historical generalisation.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1972. Tradition: Guyana. Original language: English.

candidates.title: Crossing the Mangrove (Traversée de la mangrove)
candidates.creator: Maryse Condé
candidates.rationale: A village’s incompatible memories produce a subtle investigation of community, exclusion and the limits of knowing another person.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1989. Tradition: Guadeloupe. Original language: French.

candidates.title: Cecilia Valdés
candidates.creator: Cirilo Villaverde
candidates.rationale: A major nineteenth-century account of Cuban racial, sexual and social hierarchy, included for literary scale as well as historical importance.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1882; expanded version of an earlier work. Tradition: Cuba. Original language: Spanish.

candidates.title: We Slaves of Suriname (Wij slaven van Suriname)
candidates.creator: Anton de Kom
candidates.rationale: Rewrites colonial history from the perspective of the colonised, joining collective memory to a personal and political voice.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1934. Tradition: Suriname. Original language: Dutch.

candidates.title: Zami: A New Spelling of My Name
candidates.creator: Audre Lorde
candidates.rationale: A formally inventive account of self-making in which relationships, sexuality, memory and inherited Caribbean connections remain inseparable.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1982. Tradition: Grenadian / United States diaspora. Original language: English.

candidates.title: Simple Verses (Versos sencillos)
candidates.creator: José Martí
candidates.rationale: Apparent simplicity supports a highly memorable lyric voice, joining private feeling to ethical and national concerns.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1891. Tradition: Cuba. Original language: Spanish.

candidates.title: The History of Mary Prince
candidates.creator: Mary Prince
candidates.rationale: Foundational testimony whose power also requires attention to the complicated mediation of transcription and abolitionist editing.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1831. Tradition: Bermuda / Antigua / Britain. Original language: English.

candidates.title: Jamaica Labrish
candidates.creator: Louise Bennett
candidates.rationale: A central assertion of vernacular artistry: wit and performance carry cultural authority that standard-language hierarchies had denied.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1966. Tradition: Jamaica. Original language: Jamaican Creole / English.

candidates.title: Motivos de son
candidates.creator: Nicolás Guillén
candidates.rationale: A compact, consequential experiment in bringing Afro-Cuban rhythm and speech into the centre of written poetry.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1930. Tradition: Cuba. Original language: Spanish / Afro-Cuban speech.

candidates.title: Dézafi
candidates.creator: Frankétienne
candidates.rationale: A landmark Creole-language novel whose formal energy and zombification allegory expand the possibilities of political fiction.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1975. Tradition: Haiti. Original language: Haitian Creole.

candidates.title: General Sun, My Brother (Compère Général Soleil)
candidates.creator: Jacques Stephen Alexis
candidates.rationale: A substantial synthesis of intimate survival, social struggle and the tragic vulnerability of Haitian workers.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1955. Tradition: Haiti. Original language: French.

candidates.title: Double Play (Dubbelspel)
candidates.creator: Frank Martinus Arion
candidates.rationale: A game of dominoes becomes an intricately constructed account of power, gender and the social possibilities of the island.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1973. Tradition: Curaçao. Original language: Dutch.

candidates.title: Macho Camacho’s Beat (La guaracha del Macho Camacho)
candidates.creator: Luis Rafael Sánchez
candidates.rationale: Popular music and urban voices drive an unusually inventive satire of class, consumerism and Puerto Rican life.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1976. Tradition: Puerto Rico. Original language: Spanish.

candidates.title: Crossing the River
candidates.creator: Caryl Phillips
candidates.rationale: Dispersed lives and fractured chronology make the history of the African diaspora an intimate problem of loss and connection.
candidates.note: Original publication: 1993. Tradition: Saint Kitts / Britain. Original language: English.
